description: Inspect an active archive, application package, firmware container (including FIT and legacy uImage), or Node.js SEA carrier in one call. By default returns the complete content-addressed artifact graph once, as the typed nested inventory Evidence, with root and integrity observations, integrity contradictions, hypotheses, unexplored branches, limitations, and next probes inline. Bun standalone inventory describes stored module, sourcemap and opaque bytecode regions. For PCK, Bun and large containers prefer detail summary: it retains the complete inspection and returns its derived summary view; read exact paths, batch occurrence/content IDs and selected fields with inspect_analysis_view using parent_evidence_id. This changes delivery, not inventory coverage. Classic iNES includes header facts, PRG/CHR file-region hashes and byte-exact reconstruction evidence; mapper execution and CPU bank mappings remain unobserved. Read-only DMG mounting is used automatically on supported macOS hosts. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue keeps mismatches explicitly untrusted. It does not extract files; use extract_artifact to materialize regular contents of supported formats. DMG extraction is unavailable; use a caller-managed read-only mount on macOS to access its files.

detail.description: Omitted or complete returns the complete inspection Evidence. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id for inventory views.
